# TIKA-4797 manual migration overlay (core scope, adjudicated + confirmed 2026-07-28)
# The moves/removals the field-identity join could NOT auto-bridge. Everything else auto-renames.
# v3<TAB>v4    (v4 = DROPPED means 4.x no longer emits it; not bridgeable)
meta:mapi-from-representing-email
meta:mapi-from-representing-name
meta:mapi-importance
meta:mapi-is-flagged
meta:mapi-message-class
meta:mapi-recipients-string
meta:mapi-sent-by-server-type
# CONSOLIDATION not clean rename: 4.x removed the client-submit key and repoints PST's
# getClientSubmitTime() into SUBMISSION_ACCEPTED_AT_TIME (distinct MAPI props -> mislabel).
# --> IF patches/MAPI-client-submit-time.patch is applied, retarget this to  mapi:msg-client-submit-time
#     (a CLEAN rename). Until then, the value follows to submission-accepted, so this maps there.
meta:mapi-msg-client-submit-time
# DROPPED (confirmed intentional): 4.x OutlookPSTParser sets TikaCoreProperties.INTERNAL_PATH
# (tk:internal-path) = folderPath + "/" + item-name on each mail item -> the folder path became the
# full item path, a SUPERSET. Not a 1:1 value, so the key-rename bridge can't reproduce the folder-only
# value; document "folder path now part of tk:internal-path". Not bridgeable as a rename.
pst:folderPath
# RTF embedded-object fields: 4.x renamed the Java fields EMB_* -> EMBEDDED_* AND the keys
# rtf_meta:emb_* -> rtf:embedded-*, so field-identity can't bridge them. Clean renames (targets
# verified present in the 4.x closed set); fuzzy suggested each correctly.
rtf_meta:emb_app_version
rtf_meta:emb_class
rtf_meta:emb_item
rtf_meta:emb_topic
